subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should Discord edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel be default-on bundled Discord plugin behavior, or should the linked implementation use opt-in or narrower semantics?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the feature is missing, but the linked implementation changes live Discord session and cancellation behavior for existing users, which requires maintainer product intent beyond code review.

options.title: Accept default-on after proof
options.body: Land the linked PR path after code review and live Discord proof show edits reprocess and deletes cancel only exact source-message work.

options.title: Require opt-in behavior
options.body: Ask the linked PR to add a narrow Discord config gate or staged rollout before existing users receive edit/delete behavior.

options.title: Split cancellation semantics
options.body: Ship edit-to-reprocess first and track delete-to-cancel separately if cancellation behavior is too risky for the same change.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on after proof
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR path after code review and live Discord proof show edits reprocess and deletes cancel only exact source-message work.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across the Discord listener, gateway, startup, handler, and queue surfaces involved in the final semantics.
